text:
We're hiring a Backend Engineer.

The role is 100% remote, working across EU timezones, and pays €70,000–€95,000 a year. You'll work mainly in Go and PostgreSQL. The hiring process is three interview rounds.

If you like clean APIs, good concurrency design, and reliable databases, and you enjoy hard problems and shipping code that matters, we'd like to hear from you. We think good engineering happens when talented people feel supported and trusted, and we try to build that into the team every day.

To apply, comment, send us a DM, or apply directly.
